name: Brevo
line: Campaigns, automation and app email in one service.

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. It is free only if each campaign is queued again by hand over four days.
5,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails a month. The Starter plan's 20,000-email tier fits, but the exact total was not verified.
10,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails a month. A Starter volume tier fits, but the exact total was not verified.
50,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 200,000 emails a month. A Standard volume tier fits, but the exact total was not verified.

appmail.math: 3,000 emails a month, which is 30 days × 100 a day, one recipient per message. Assumes 500 stored contacts, one user and one domain, a shared IP, no attachments, and no marketing sends or workflow runs.
10,000 emails a month. A Starter tier covers it, but the exact total was not verified.
50,000 emails a month. A Starter tier covers it, but the exact total was not verified.
100,000 emails a month. The Starter plan's ceiling is 100,000 emails, and the exact total was not verified.
